verdict.rationale: Highnote's docs clearly position it as a program-management platform that absorbs compliance, KYC/KYB, disputes, and ledger work (highnote-docs-23, highnote-docs-10, highnote-docs-3) and explicitly markets 'launch or migrate your card program with speed' plus a test environment that 'behaves like production' (highnote-docs-24, highnote-docs-26, highnote-docs-11), which supports the 'don't become a bank' pitch. However, there is no explicit mention of BIN sponsorship or network membership terms, nor any documented concrete timeline (e.g., days/weeks) from signup to first live card. missing for 10: explicit BIN sponsorship/network membership language, a documented signup-to-first-live-card timeframe or case study, independent corroboration of onboarding speed.
